title: Reference approach: Handwritten Digit Classifier
approach: Build Handwritten Digit Classifier in small milestones. Implement: Load and inspect a documented digit dataset; Build a baseline MLP; Implement training and validation loops; Report classification metrics; Save weights and predict on new images. Use synthetic data while developing, choose a documented dataset for the final experiment, and keep train/validation/test splits separate.

import torch
from torch import nn
model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8, 16), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(16, 2)).eval()
with torch.inference_mode():
    output = model(torch.zeros(1, 8))
assert output.shape == (1, 2)
print("smoke test passed")
